description: Find Roomba j7+ replacement filters, rubber roller brushes, side brushes and Clean Base bags. Compare exact fit, pack sizes and care intervals before ordering.
scope: Choose the j7+ replacement filter, rubber rollers, side brush or Clean Base bag you need. These Amazon listings name the j7+; check your model label and the selected pack before ordering.

compatibility.detail: iRobot's j-series care chart and its e/i/j replenishment-kit listing cover the j7 and j7+ robot parts. The plus sign identifies the self-emptying package: Clean Base bags are only needed when a Clean Base is installed.

compatibility.part: Robot parts vs. Clean Base bags
compatibility.detail: Filters, rubber rollers and the edge-sweeping brush are robot consumables. The disposable bag belongs inside the Clean Base dock. iRobot says its bags fit Clean Base models; a j7 owner without that dock does not need a bag.

Combo j7+ (C755020) is a separate vacuum-and-mop model. iRobot states that the standard e/i/j replenishment kit is not compatible with Combo j7+; verify every accessory against the Combo-specific listing. The side-brush and bag sellers may list Combo models, but that does not prove their filters or rollers fit.
All four replacement consumable listings on this page are third-party products. Compatibility statements come from the Amazon sellers and have not been independently fit-tested by DustMigo.

careTip: iRobot says j-series filters are not washable: tap debris off and keep the filter dry. Clean the main brushes weekly, or twice weekly in homes with pets. The Clean Base/app prompt is the replacement cue for a full bag; a red light can also mean the bag is missing or not seated correctly.

questions.question: Do the same replacement parts fit Roomba j7 and j7+?
questions.answer: iRobot's j-series chart and standard e/i/j refill kit cover the j7 and j7+ robot parts. The important package difference is the Clean Base: j7+ includes it, while j7 does not unless the dock was purchased separately. Only buy bags if your setup has that base.

questions.question: Can I use these j7+ parts on Roomba Combo j7+?
questions.answer: Do not use this guide for Combo j7+ as a whole. iRobot says its standard e/i/j replenishment kit is not compatible with Combo j7+. Some individual sellers list a shared side brush or dock bag, but that does not establish fit for the filter or rollers.

questions.question: How often should I replace the Roomba j7+ filter and brushes?
questions.answer: iRobot's j-series chart recommends replacing the filter every 2 months and the dual brushes every 6–12 months. It gives no fixed replacement interval for the edge-sweeping brush; clean it monthly and replace it when worn or damaged.

questions.question: Are these genuine iRobot replacement parts?
questions.answer: No. The four linked consumable products are third-party listings from EAGLEGGO, Pivxsnkew, neutop and VBN. Their sellers list Roomba j7+ compatibility; DustMigo has not independently tested fit or performance. The original j7+ robot listing is shown separately below.
